title: Optional FocalBI saved chart presentation flags

focalbi_treemap_group_colors.description: Opt-in treemap parent colours keyed by exact first grouping values. Descendants receive stable lighter shades of the parent's colour; unconfigured groups retain native colours.

focalbi_disable_map_drag.description: Disable deck.gl pan/rotation drag gestures while retaining hover, picking and zoom.

focalbi_disable_map_zoom.description: Disable wheel, double-click, pinch and keyboard camera controls. Combined with disable_map_drag locks the camera while native autozoom still fits chart dimensions.

focalbi_hide_native_renderer_label.description: Omit the diagnostic native-renderer fallback label for this chart.
